verdicts.title: Hodge level for weighted complete intersections
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We give lower bounds for Hodge numbers of smooth well formed Fano weighted complete intersections. In particular, we compute their Hodge level, that is, the maximal distance between non-trivial Hodge numbers in the same row of the Hodge diamond. This allows us to classify varieties whose Hodge numbers are like that of a projective space, of a curve, or of a Calabi--Yau variety of low dimension.

It shares the 'Hodge' vocabulary but does not interact with the conjecture's claim about circuit complexity.

verdicts.title: Noncommutative Hodge conjecture
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The paper provides a version of the rational Hodge conjecture for $\3\dg$ categories. The noncommutative Hodge conjecture is equivalent to the version proposed in \cite{perry2020integral} for admissible subcategories. We obtain examples of evidence of the Hodge conjecture by techniques of noncommutative geometry. Finally, we show that the noncommutative Hodge conjecture for smooth proper connective $\3\dg$ algebras is true.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract discusses a noncommutative version of the rational Hodge conjecture for dg categories, with no mention of Boolean circuits, CNF formulas, circuit depth, or any computational complexity notion. It shares only the 'Hodge' vocabulary with the conjecture.
